_methodology: Every label emitted by Regex, Presidio, GLiNER, or spaCy is mapped to a single canonical PromptShield EntityType string. Ground-truth labels are also expressed in these canonical values. Matching is performed on canonical labels only.

ground_truth_label_normalization._comment: Maps raw ground-truth JSON labels to canonical PromptShield EntityType for scoring.

ground_truth_label_normalization_notes.USERNAME: Mapped to USER_ID — PromptShield EntityType has no USERNAME; USER_ID is the closest canonical equivalent.
ground_truth_label_normalization_notes.PASSPORT_NUMBER: Mapped to null — PromptShield has no PASSPORT_NUMBER EntityType. Excluded from TP/FN scoring. Tracked in coverage as unsupported.
ground_truth_label_normalization_notes.NATIONAL_ID: Mapped to null — not a defined PromptShield EntityType.
ground_truth_label_normalization_notes.MAC_ADDRESS: Mapped to null — not a defined PromptShield EntityType.
ground_truth_label_normalization_notes.UUID: Mapped to null — not a defined PromptShield EntityType.
ground_truth_label_normalization_notes.IFSC: Mapped to null — not a defined PromptShield EntityType.
ground_truth_label_normalization_notes.NATIONALITY: Mapped to null — not a defined PromptShield EntityType.
ground_truth_label_normalization_notes.MEDICAL_INFORMATION: Mapped to null — not a defined PromptShield EntityType.
ground_truth_label_normalization_notes.MEDICATION: Mapped to null — not a defined PromptShield EntityType.
ground_truth_label_normalization_notes.EMPLOYEE_ID: Mapped to null — no EMPLOYEE_ID EntityType in PromptShield.

matching_rules.match_type: STRICT — exact character-span AND exact canonical label must both match.
matching_rules.tp_condition: prediction.start == gt.start AND prediction.end == gt.end AND canonical(prediction.label) == canonical(gt.label)
matching_rules.fp_condition: prediction has no matching ground-truth entity by strict span+label
matching_rules.fn_condition: ground-truth entity has no matching prediction by strict span+label
matching_rules.unsupported_gt_labels: GT entities whose label maps to null are excluded from TP/FN. Tracked separately in coverage analysis.
matching_rules.partial_spans: Counted as FP (wrong prediction) + FN (missed GT). Not a TP.
matching_rules.wrong_label: Counted as FP (wrong label) + FN (GT entity missed with correct type).
matching_rules.duplicates: If the system emits two identical span+label entities, only the first is TP; the second is FP.
